scripts.test: pnpm run test:ui && pnpm run test:agent && pnpm run lint
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:all || { printf '\n✗ Lint errors detected. Run "pnpm fix" to automatically fix formatting and auto-fixable lint issues.\n' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.lint:all: pnpm run lint:ui && pnpm run lint:agent && pnpm run lint:deploy
scripts.lint:ui: pnpm -C ui run lint:type-check && pnpm run lint:biome
scripts.lint:agent: cd agent && uv run ruff format --check . ../deploy && uv run ruff check . ../deploy && uv run mypy
scripts.lint:deploy: pnpm run lint:terraform && pnpm run lint:shell && pnpm run lint:docker
scripts.lint:terraform: terraform fmt -check -recursive deploy/terraform-custom-datacommons/ && (cd deploy/terraform-custom-datacommons/modules && terraform init -backend=false -input=false >/dev/null && terraform validate)
scripts.lint:shell: files=$(find . -name '*.sh' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.venv/*' | sed 's|^\./||' | grep -vxFf .lintignore || true); [ -z "$files" ] || printf '%s\n' "$files" | xargs uv run --project agent shellcheck
scripts.lint:docker: files=$(find . -name '*Dockerfile*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.venv/*' | sed 's|^\./||' | grep -vxFf .lintignore || true); [ -z "$files" ] || printf '%s\n' "$files" | xargs uv run --project agent hadolint
scripts.fix: pnpm run fix:ui && pnpm run fix:agent && pnpm run fix:terraform
scripts.fix:agent: cd agent && uv run ruff check --fix . ../deploy && uv run ruff format . ../deploy
